changelog:
Initial release of Crawl Pro: a production-grade scraping workflow based on Scrapling.

- Supports adaptive element location, anti-bot bypass, scalable concurrent crawling, and proxy rotation.
- Easily selects environment and fetcher for static, dynamic, and anti-bot sites.
- Built-in checkpointing for resumable crawls and streamlined concurrent spider definitions.
- Exports data in multiple formats (JSONL, JSON, CSV) with real-time streaming and pipeline customization.
- Integrates AI (MCP server) for smarter scraping and reduced token usage.
